headline: Defense Evasion becomes Stealth across 271 rules; 12 new detectors, including Git token theft by a JS runtime
summary_md:
- An ATT&CK re-map touched almost every rule: **Defense Evasion (TA0005)** is now **Stealth**, a new **Defense Impairment (TA0112)** tactic appears, and the **Impair Defenses (T1562)** subtree splits into **Disable or Modify Tools (T1685)**, **Disable or Modify System Firewall (T1686)** and **Downgrade Attack (T1689)**.
- **12 detectors were added**: three AWS, three Exchange mailbox-access, two macOS AppleScript, plus Git token theft, early-startup persistence, an uncommon-command detector and one re-published rule.
- One rule changed path: `uncommon-user-management-via-net-exe` was deleted and re-published as `uncommon-user-management-via-net-command`, gaining five variations.
- Variations arrived where there were none — the AI causality-combination rule went from an empty list to 46 entries.
- Of the 288 modified rules, 271 changed nothing but their tactic and technique labels.

highlights.title: Defense Evasion (TA0005) is renamed Stealth, and a Defense Impairment (TA0112) tactic is added
highlights.detail: 271 modified rules lost the Defense Evasion label and 89 also moved off an Impair Defenses (T1562) technique, so most of this day's 302-file diff is relabelling rather than detection logic.

highlights.title: A new detector names the Mini Shai Hulud campaign
highlights.detail: "JS runtime attempted to read Git authentication tokens" flags a .js file running `gh auth token`, with a High-severity variation when the runtime itself is uncommon.

highlights.title: Uncommon user management via net.exe was withdrawn and re-published as net command
highlights.detail: The only deletion of the day: the rule moved to a new path, dropped ".exe" from its name and description, and gained five variations covering renamed LOLBINs, web server processes, untrusted CGO and RMM tools.

highlights.title: Three new Exchange mailbox-access detectors ship under the Identity Threat Module
highlights.detail: They cover one caller IP reading a single mailbox repeatedly, one IP reaching many users' mail, and one user's mailbox accessed from rotating IPs inside a single /16 subnet.

highlights.title: Three new AWS detectors cover log tampering and data destruction
highlights.detail: Route53 DNS Resolver query logging deletion, KMS key policy changes, and mass deletion of versioned S3 objects — the last tagged for ransomware-style purging of recoverable versions.

highlights.title: The AI causality-combination rule gained 46 variations
highlights.detail: Its variations list was previously empty; each new entry names a specific combination of alerts seen under one causality chain, mostly at High severity under Execution (TA0002).

items.analytics/js-runtime-attempted-to-read-g: New Medium detector for a .js file reading Git personal access tokens via `gh auth token`, attributed to the Mini Shai Hulud campaign.
items.analytics/uncommon-user-management-via-n: Replaces the net.exe rule at a new path, with five new variations for renamed LOLBINs, web server processes, untrusted CGO and RMM tools.
Deleted; re-published as uncommon-user-management-via-net-command, so links to this path no longer resolve.
items.analytics/single-ip-accessed-mail-items-: New detector for one caller IP reading mail across multiple mailboxes, described as harvesting from a shared VPS or AiTM box.
items.analytics/user-mail-items-accessed-from-: New detector for a mailbox reached from rotating IPs in one /16, aimed at VPS abuse that evades per-IP velocity controls.
items.analytics/multiple-mail-items-were-acces: New detector for a single caller IP reading one mailbox an unusually high number of times in a short window.
items.analytics/mass-deletion-of-versioned-s3-: New detector for high-frequency deletion of S3 object versions, with variations for production accounts and buckets holding sensitive data.
items.analytics/aws-route53-dns-resolver-query: New Cloud detector for deletion of Route53 DNS Resolver query logging, escalating when the identity is not an admin.
items.analytics/kms-key-policy-was-changed: New Cloud detector for AWS KMS key policy modification, tagged Data Detection & Response.
items.analytics/uncommon-applescript-with-a-po: New macOS detector for AppleScript modifying system configuration or bypassing security controls.
New macOS detector for AppleScript run from the command line carrying a system information discovery command.
items.analytics/execution-of-an-uncommon-proce: New Low detector for boot-time execution under a local or domain user SID, tagged Generic Persistence Analytics.
items.analytics/uncommon-command-was-executed-: New Informational detector for uncommon commands on a device, with a variation for uncommon sensitive commands.
items.analytics/ai-determined-combination-of-r: Gained 46 variations, each naming a specific alert combination under one causality chain; the list was previously empty.
items.analytics/unusual-cloud-instance-metadat: Gained a variation for IMDS requests made by a lightweight JavaScript runtime executing a script.
